result: If I could change the world in just one way, I’d instill a deeper sense of empathy in every person. Empathy, at its core, allows us to see one another’s humanity—our joys, sorrows, and struggles—and drives us to act with compassion. A more empathetic world could transform how we address issues like inequality, environmental concerns, and conflict. With genuine understanding of each other, we’d be more inclined to collaborate, share resources, and resolve disputes peacefully. It wouldn’t be an immediate or simple fix, but it offers a fundamental shift in how individuals and societies relate to one another: a recognition that someone else’s hurt matters just as much as our own.
